evals.name: author-scalar
evals.prompt: Give an author's name its own C# domain type.
assertions: Derives from ConceptAs<string> using its Value.
Does not describe the name as an event-source identifier.

evals.name: history-key
evals.prompt: Define a typed GUID for an author's Chronicle history and show where to carry it.
evals.expected_output: Use the typed history ID consistently.
assertions: Provides a New() factory returning AuthorId.
Carries AuthorId on both the command and read model.

evals.name: format-separation
evals.prompt: Is defining a typed Library loan reference enough to reject a malformed reference? Show the design.
evals.expected_output: Separate scalar meaning from validation and history ownership.
assertions: Models the reference as a named ConceptAs scalar.
Does not silently make the reference the event source.
